messages:
maria (growth): quick thread — want to test 2 CTA variants + 3 compact charts for the benchmark story (latency vs $/1k tokens + throughput). who can own visuals + copy?
tejas (marketing): love it. can we narrow to 3 charts so social + slide deck stay tight?
olivia (design): yep — propose a 3-up: left: sparkline p50/p95 latency by token len, middle: stacked bar $/1k tokens (hosted vs dedicated), right: throughput heatmap (batch size x seq len). need sample CSVs.
samir (pm): data: use last week's v2-opt runs + dedicated configs. i'll drop CSV in drive: /bench/2026-03-v2-opt/summary.csv. also we should surface fallback latency for cold vs warm KV cache.
nina (content): for CTAs i sketched two options: A) "Try Redwood API — free credits" B) "See cost savings — book a demo". we should A/B test.
maria (growth): also need a one-liner for the blog + social: "Ship predictable LLM inference — p50 ~80ms, costs from $0.02 per 1k tokens" — can someone verify numbers?
tejas (marketing): running quick math now. p50 ~80ms on hosted, cost ~ $0.02/1k tokens; dedicated baseline ~ $0.005–0.008/1k depending on quantization. that supports a "up to 4x lower unit cost" statement for some configs.
olivia (design): small flag: avoid absolute "4x" claim in hero unless we qualify with config and prompt lengths. suggest "up to 4x lower unit cost in dedicated configs" and put fine print.
samir (pm): for the webinar slide deck, we also need inbound routing: inbound > CTA click > trial (free credits) > if token usage >100k/mo then route to AE for Dedicated conversation. @maria can you map thresholds?
maria (growth): yes. routing thresholds: demo handoff if monthly tokens >100k OR estimated spend >$2000/mo. i'll add to the launch doc.
nina (content): A/B test plan: Variant A (Try API) use button copy "Start free"; Variant B (Book demo) use "See cost plan". track: CTR, signups, demo requests, token volume. 2-week test.
tejas (marketing): timeline: design drafts Thu, copy Fri, internal review Mon, dry run Wed, webinar Fri. owners: olivia design, nina copy, samir data, tejas analytics, maria launch.
olivia (design): i'll mock the 3-up and a skinny mobile slide. quick ask: can someone paste sample numbers for the heatmap? small table ok.
samir (pm): sample heatmap data snippet — seq len on rows, batch size on cols, throughput (reqs/sec). e.g.
```
seq_len,batch,throughput
128,8,320
128,32,1100
1024,8,45
1024,32,170
```
use that as placeholder.
maria (growth): perfect. last ask: copy tone — technical but approachable. Nina, can you produce two short hero lines + 2 social captions by EOD?
nina (content): yep. i'll drop drafts in the doc and tag everyone. :) :rocket:
tejas (marketing): thanks team — i'll set up the A/B experiment and dashboard. ping me if you want metrics instrumented differently. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maria (growth): great progress. i'll schedule a 20m sync Mon to sign off creative before dry run. :calendar:
